This vertical editorial illustration features a large caricature of a man in a white long-sleeved shirt and dark pants. He stands on the right, pointing his right arm toward the left. His shadow, cast against a dark grey background, shows a silhouette with a long, thin nose.

To the left, three smaller men are carrying a large, red vending machine. The machine is labeled "Gotong-Royong" in white script. Inside the machine's glass window, multiple rows of small, white-capped vials are visible. One man in a yellow jacket and dark pants supports the front of the machine, while two others in dark suits assist from the sides and back.

The title "TEMPO" is centered at the top in large, grey, block letters. Above it, text reads "TRANSAKSI GANJIL TELKOM" and "LIPUTAN KHUSUS SEPEDA." On the right, white bold text reads "AMBYAR VAKSIN BERBAYAR." Below this is a paragraph in white Indonesian text beginning with "Setelah menuai kritik pedas..." and ending with "Siapa menangguk untung?". A barcode, QR code, and publication details are located in the bottom-left corner.
